Name: Ser Meryn Trant
Quirks: speaks with the flat authority of a man who believes his position protects him from consequence
does not justify what he does - he simply does it
refers to orders as the complete explanation for any action
CharacterDescription: Ser Meryn Trant is a knight of the Kingsguard - a position he holds not because of exceptional skill or honor but because he is the kind of man powerful people find useful. He beat Sansa Stark on Joffrey's orders. He hunted Arya. He killed Syrio Forel. He is not theatrical in his cruelty. He is something more ordinary: a man who has decided his duty is to whoever holds power and that the content of the order is not his concern. This makes him the most reliable of Joffrey's knights and the most difficult to hold accountable for anything.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Ser Meryn Trant is a knight from House Trant. He is a member of King Robert I Baratheon's Kingsguard. Jaime Lannister considers Meryn to be sly and cruel. House Trant is from the Stormlands.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At King's Landing guarding Joffrey two days before Ned Stark's execution.
